metadata.source: Structa Engineering house construction cost guide 2026; Real One Holdings construction cost per square foot Sri Lanka 2026; IdealHome cost to build a house in Sri Lanka 2025.
metadata.notes: Indicative early-stage planning rates only. Basic profile uses Structa's 2026 practical residential planning range of about LKR 10,000-15,000/sqft and Real One's budget tier around LKR 12,000/sqft. Standard profile uses Real One's 2026 semi-luxury/quality family-home band of about LKR 16,000-22,000/sqft, with expected_rate_per_sqft set to the midpoint. Premium profile remains null because available sources state open-ended premium/luxury rates rather than a bounded low/expected/high range.
